title: Vortex Sour Blueberry Raspberry 10ml Nic Salt E-Liquid
description: Tidal Vape Vortex Nic Salt Sour Blueberry Raspberry pairs the tangy sweetness of Blueberry with the sharp bite of Raspberry, enhanced by a zesty sour twist. This flavour delivers a bright and layered vape, perfect for fans of sour-inspired fruit blends. Blended with a 50VG/50PG ratio, this nicotine salt e-liquid provides smooth vapour and bold flavour, making it ideal for Mouth-To-Lung (MTL) pod kits and starter devices. The nic salt formulation ensures a smooth throat hit and rapid nicotine relief, offering a flavour-packed option for everyday vaping. Tidal Vape Vortex Nic Salts come in a convenient 10ml format, providing a more economical and less wasteful alternative to disposable vape bars. Available in 10mg and 20mg nicotine strengths, Sour Blueberry Raspberry is a vibrant choice for adult vapers.
